title: Battle off Liverpool, Nova Scotia (1778)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle off Liverpool, Nova Scotia (1778)", at revision 1375197167, opens: "The Battle of Liverpool took place on 24 April 1778 during the American Revolutionary War. The raid involved the British vessel HMS Blonde and the French 24-gun frigate Duc de Choiseul."
